title: The body of POST /send
description: Sends a WhatsApp message, as docs/API.md describes it. Keys the bridge does not know are ignored; keys are added, never renamed or removed.

jid.description: The chat: …@s.whatsapp.net, …@lid or …@g.us, or a phone number with the country code for the direct chat with it.

text.description: Sent as it is, split into numbered parts when it is longer than max_chunk_size.
